{"c_0_core_nature":"Aristotelian four causes (material, efficient, formal, final) unified as living psychological-ontological dynamics rather than mechanical sequences; causation and meaning inseparable","c_0_essence":"Operates as first explicate position providing material foundation that subsequent positions (epistemological #2, processual #3, meta-epistemic #4) build upon and refine","c_1_description":"The causal lens operates as position #1 in the MEF six-fold structure, representing the first explicit manifestation after numerical ground. Whitehead's process philosophy shows all four causes operating simultaneously in every actual occasion, not as separate mechanisms but as four dimensions of one unified concrescence. {"c_0_core_nature":"Whiteheadian concrescence as universal rhythm of becoming, revealed through natural symbolic cycle: Soil → Seeding → Sprouting → Blooming → Flowering → Maturity","c_0_essence":"Operates as third explicate position providing ontological traversal showing how being itself becomes; concrescence as universal pattern all entities follow in actualizing","c_1_description":"The processual lens operates as position #3 in the MEF six-fold structure, representing ontological investigation (\"how does being become?\").
